messages.author: d5124cd091a46db4
messages.subject: ggplot2
parts:
I want to plot table object with ggplot. This is very easy with plot: plot(df). The solution I found is:
 ggplot(as.data.frame(table(df)), aes(x=gender, y = Freq, fill=fraud)) + geom_bar(stat="identity")

Can I do it without define aes (because each table has other names)?

Avner

ggplot seems to map different tables correctly
